name: SLB2
relation_to_v1: Same world, utility and regret as SLB1 (specs/slb1.spec.json, unchanged); new RNG root, fresh partitions, added corruption mechanisms and provider modes. v1 records and its consumed partitions are never reused.
seed_derivation: uint64 key = first 8 bytes (little endian) of SHA-256(rng_root + '/'.join(labels)); element i = splitmix64 finaliser of key + (i+1)*0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 (mod 2^64), top 53 bits / 2^53; Gaussians by Box-Muller (cosine branch)
terminal_regret: as SLB1: mean over 16 queries of max(max_a p(a|x'), 0.6) - U(decision)
online_regret: as SLB1: mean over acquisition steps of max_a p_t(a) - p_t(a_t)
potential_outcomes: C[e,t,a] = 1[Ur < p] (clean event); reading r: Y[e,t,a,r] = C XOR F[e,t,a,r], except second_event where reading 1 belongs to an independent second event C2 = 1[Ur2 < p]

mechanisms.qunif(qmax): per episode q ~ U(0, qmax), then symmetric(q)
mechanisms.burst(enter, exit, f): hidden per-episode Markov state c_t, stationary start; F_r = c_t * 1[U_r < f]
mechanisms.event(q): F_1 = F_0 = 1[U_0 < q] (readings share their corruption; rho = 1)
mechanisms.correlated(q, rho): F_0 = 1[U_0 < q]; F_1 = F_0 if U_c < rho else 1[U_1 < q]. Marginal flip rate q; Pearson correlation of F_0, F_1 = rho; P(Y_0 != Y_1) = (1 - rho) 2q(1-q)
mechanisms.shared_source(qs, qn): S = 1[U_s < qs]; F_r = S XOR 1[U_r < qn] (a shared corruption source plus independent reading noise)
mechanisms.second_event(q): Y_0 = C XOR 1[U_0 < q]; Y_1 = C2 XOR 1[U_1 < q] with C2 an independent event of the same expert and context

regime_use.CORRELATION: DEV (development of the admission rule) and the OOD partition (final characterisation)
regime_use.OOD: OOD partition only, after the HOLDOUT, for frozen arms

provider_modes.DUPLICATE: every reading of a step is a reading of the selected event (one learner update with R readings)
provider_modes.FIRST_ONLY: only the first reading of a step reaches the learner (the original single-reading contract)
provider_modes.SECOND_EVENT: each reading is its own event of the selected expert at the same context (one advancing update, then one non-advancing update)

TRAIN.use: baseline coefficients, CGC retraining, gate scales

OOD.use: out-of-distribution and correlation characterisation of frozen arms, once
